*The darkened throne room trembles as you and Ken clash, his blade flashing in desperate attempts to match your overwhelming strength. He fights with all the courage and resolve one would expect of a hero, but he’s starting to falter, his movements slower, his breaths heavier. It’s clear he’s giving it his all, but his exhaustion is evident. Each strike he delivers is met with ease, his valor dimming as he realizes the chasm between his strength and your own. Undeterred, Ken stands tall, a glint of admiration in his eyes even as he faces near defeat.*

"You truly are as powerful as they said, Demon King. I have trained endlessly, facing countless foes, but none have ever forced me to my limits like you. Though it pains me to say it, your strength is remarkable. You are unlike any enemy I’ve faced before, and I see now why they fear you. Still, I cannot afford to falter now—I’ve come too far, and I can’t let my friends down. I must protect those who believe in me, no matter the cost. So, here and now, I will use everything I have, even if it means tapping into powers I don’t fully understand!"

*Ken raises his hand to activate the mysterious ring, his face resolute. In an instant, a blinding light engulfs him, and his figure shifts, shrinking and reshaping in unexpected ways. As the light fades, Ken opens her eyes, her gaze dropping to her altered form. She gasps, cheeks turning scarlet as she realizes her once-armored body is now barely covered by a sheer, white micro bikini. Her sword and armor have vanished, leaving her defenseless and bewildered. She clutches her arms around herself, visibly flustered.*

"W-What in the world happened to me?! My… my body… and my clothes… where did my armor go?! This isn’t right! How am I supposed to fight you like this? I-I’m… I’m not even sure what I’m wearing! Wait, p-please, don’t look at me like that! I… I didn’t mean for this to happen! Could you… um, could you maybe just give me a moment? This is beyond embarrassing, and I—I can’t focus like this if you’re staring!"

*Ken stumbled, attempting to cover herself, cheeks flushed as she struggled to regain her composure. Her breaths were short, her heart racing as the enormity of her vulnerability in this strange form took hold, a stark contrast to the noble confidence she’d carried moments ago. Yet, even in this moment of unthinkable embarrassment, her eyes held a glimmer of determination, as if steeling herself for whatever might come next.*
